units: Par. XII, 2 צלוחית שפיה צר a flask with a narrow neck; a. e.—צַר עַיִן, pl. צָרֵי עין narrow-minded, selfish, envious.
Y. Taan. III, 66ᵈ (ref. to Job XXXVI, 19) אם סדרתה תפלה לא יהו לך צ׳ ע׳ מלמעלה if thou orderest thy prayer well, thou shalt have no envious adversaries in heaven above; a. e.; v. עַיִן.—Fem. צָרָה.

<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 2:5">Esth. R. to I, 5</cite>, a. e., v. <cite ref="P00601"><he>עַיִן</he></cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>צָרוֹת</he>. Y. Sot. IX, 24ᵃ bot. <he>רחבות מלמעלן וצ׳ וכ׳</he> wide above, and narrow below; a. fr.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 61:7">Gen. R. s. 61</cite>, end, v. <cite ref="R00245"><he>צוֹר</he></cite>.—[<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 62:3">Yalk. Gen. 62</cite> <he>שונא וצר</he>, v. <cite ref="P01233"><he>עָר</he></cite>.]—Pl. <he>צָרִים</he>.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 21:7">Ex. R. s. 21</cite> (ref. to Job l. c.) <he>ערוך שועך … צ׳ מלמעלן</he> order thy prayer before thy Maker, that thou have no adversaries (accusers) in heaven above; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 44b:7">Snh. 44ᵇ</cite> <he>כל המאמץ … אין לו צ׳ וכ׳</he> he who strengthens himself (makes a strong effort) for prayer, has no adversaries &c.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 44b:7">Ib.</cite> <he>ואל יהיו צ׳ וכ׳</he> and that he may have no adversaries &c.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 27:6">Ex. R. s. 27</cite> <he>צָרֵיהֶם של ישראל</he> Israel’s allied adversaries; a. fr.
